name: quest-giveup-delay
summary: A quest can be given up 3 s after the last quest dialog instead of 10 s (operator 2026-09-25).

ticks.why: an imm8 of `add edx, imm8` is sign-extended: 1..127 ticks (0.1..12.7 s)

why: ShinePlayer::sp_NC_QUEST_GIVE_UP_REQ (0x578910): `mov edx, [esi+0x5CB4]; add edx, 0x64; cmp [0x14D41A70], edx;
jae ok` - else it answers NC_QUEST_GIVE_UP_ACK err 0x0B49. [player+0x5CB4] is stamped with the global tick
(0x14D41A70, 100 ms units) by every NC_QUEST_SCRIPT_CMD_ACK (0x5783C8), so a give-up within 100 ticks = 10 s of
the last quest dialog page was refused (operator 2026-09-23: 'server error the first time, the second time it
operator asked for about 3 s (2026-09-25): the imm8 becomes `ticks` (30 = 3 s). No official capture has a
give-up, so the official delay is unknown; this applies to every product.

edits.why: give-up guard: add edx, 0x64 -> add edx, ticks (83 C2 imm8 at 0x57898E)
